problems.title: Surface of a drilled cube
problems.question: A radius 1 cylindrical hole is drilled through a side 5 cube along the centres of two opposite faces. Find the remaining solid’s surface are a.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
formulas: Start with cube are a $6\cdot5^2=150$. Remove two radius 1 disks and add the internal cylindrical wall $2\pi rh$.
steps: The removed are a is 2π. The new wall has radius 1, height 5, are a 10π. Total 150−2π+10π.

problems.title: Simplify a logarithm using an equation
problems.question: Find $\log_{a^2}(a^7-a^9)$ if a is the positive root of a⁶+a²=1.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
steps: The base a² is positive and not 1. The logarithm is the exponent ratio 13/2.

problems.title: An equation in reciprocal exponential bases
problems.question: Solve $(10+3\sqrt{11})^x+(10-3\sqrt{11})^x=20$.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
formulas: The two bases have product 1. Set $t=10+3\sqrt{11}>1$ and u=tˣ>0.
steps: The equation u+1/u=20 gives u²−20u+1=0, with roots 10±3√11=t and 1/t. Therefore tˣ=t or t⁻¹, and injectivity gives x=±1.

problems.title: Change bases through known logarithms
problems.question: Find log₂20 if log₃54=a and log₅75=b.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
steps: Use 20=4·5, so log₂20=2+log₂5. The known logarithmic differences are nonzero.

problems.title: A cone section through the apex
problems.question: A cone has radius R and generator angle α to the base. A plane through its apex makes angle φ with the height line. Find the section are a.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
formulas: The height is $h=R\tan\alpha$. The base chord cut by the plane has distance $d=h\tan\varphi$ from the base centre, length $2\sqrt{R^2-d^2}$, and section altitude $\sqrt{h^2+d^2}=h/\cos\varphi$.
steps: The are a is half chord times section altitude. Substituting h, d gives R²tanα·√(1−tan²αtan²φ)/cosφ. A nondegenerate triangular section requires 0≤φ<π/2−α; at equality the section degenerates.

problems.title: Two secants through a sphere diameter endpoint
problems.question: A sphere has diameter AD=√3 and touches plane ABC at A. BD, CD meet the sphere again at M, N. AB=3, AC=3√5, BDC=π/3. Find MN.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
formulas: AD is perpendicular to plane ABC, so $DB=\sqrt{AD^2+AB^2}=2\sqrt3$ and $DC=4\sqrt3$. Diameter angles give AM⊥DB and AN⊥DC.
steps: Projection of AD onto DB gives DM=AD²/DB=√3/2. Likewise DN=√3/4. Since M, N lie along DB, DC, angle MDN=60°.

problems.title: A monotone function solves a mixed log equation
problems.question: Solve $\log_2(x/\sqrt{4x-3})=\sqrt{4x-3}-x$.
problems.idea: Use the logarithm domain, monotonicity, or a direct geometric formula.
formulas: Domain x>3/4. Put y=√(4x−3)>0. Rearrangement gives $\log_2x+x=\log_2y+y$.
steps: The function g(t)=log₂t+t is strictly increasing for t>0, so x=y. Squaring x=√(4x−3) gives x²−4x+3=0, or x=1,3. Both are positive and directly satisfy the original equation.
